title: Objectwise root-normalized twist and restriction comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, and $n,d\in\mathbf N$. Let $R$ be the completed integral coefficient sheaf, $A$ its quotient at level $n+1$, $U$ scalar restriction from $A$-module sheaves to $R$-module sheaves, $L_d$ the integral degree-$d$ root line and $L_{d,A}$ its prescribed finite root line [def-coefficient-twists-detailed,def-pur-adic-root-comparisons]. Write $c_d:L_d\to U(L_{d,A})$ for the root-normalized quotient map. For each sheaf $M$ of $A$-modules there exists an $R$-linear isomorphism $U(M)\otimes_R L_d\simeq U(M\otimes_A L_{d,A})$ which sends every local pure tensor $x\otimes y$ to $x\otimes c_d(y)$, over every pro-etale test object. This asserts only the component for a fixed $M$; naturality and uniqueness of the natural comparison are proved separately.

source.place: Finite coefficient twist, coefficient reduction of the rank-one line, and nonnegative tensor powers; the component step of def-pur-adic-finite-tensor-realization.

proof.text: Use the root-normalized quotient c_d and the identity on M to form the sectionwise balanced pairing (x,y) ↦ x tensor c_d(y). Semilinearity of c_d and the restricted A-action on M give R-balancing. The pairings commute with restrictions. The sectionwise tensor universal property followed by module sheafification gives a morphism of R-module sheaves with the asserted pure-tensor equation.

proof.text: Trivialize the integral rank-one root line pro-etale locally. Its finite quotient is the scalar unit and c_d is coefficient projection, by the degree-zero, first-root and higher-power equations. In these coordinates the component is the unitor M tensor_A A ≅ M, so it is invertible. Isomorphy descends along a cover. At d=0 this is the coefficient-unit calculation; zero modules, zero rings and empty test objects are covered by the same universal properties.

theorem adicPurityTwistRestriction_component (d : ℕ)
    (M : scalarReductionTarget l E T n) :
    ∃ e : (integralSheafTwist l E T (d : ℤ)).obj
        ((scalarReductionRestriction l E T n).obj M) ≅
      (scalarReductionRestriction l E T n).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight
          (A := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n)
          (finiteCoefficientTwist l E T n (d : ℤ))).obj M),
      ∀ (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj W)
        (y : (integralTwistLine l E T (d : ℤ)).val.obj W),
        e.hom.val.app W
          (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul
            (A := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T) _ _ W x y) =
          SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul
            (A := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n) _ _ W x
              ((adicPurityRootQuotients l E n T d).val.app W y)
